newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar slightly weaker, hefty AA cited.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar slightly weaker, hefty AA cited.

text.p: White sugar futures edged lower from settlement prices in heavy early trading on Tuesday with the emphasis remaining fixed on the approaching March expiry, traders said.

The solid turnover was mainly due to a hefty crossed AA of around 750 lots on March, posted by one leading commission house. Some trade buying of the positions was also noted but price movements were generally tight.

The nearby March/May spread traded out to $3.40, wider than the $2.70/3.20 bid/offer close, as traders continued to roll forward before Thursday's spot expir and May/August traded at a discount of 30 cents.
At 1215 GMT all positions were slightly weaker, with March down 30 cents at $303.30 after trading in a range of just 40 cents. May was down 60 cents at $300.00.

Traders noted the declining open position on March and said a large physical delivery against the contract was looking less likely. European Union and Polish sugars are expected to be tendered, they said.
Paris positions were also weaker but volume was on the light side at 191 lots.
March was down 70 cents at $304.00 and May down $1.70 at $299.50.
